description: USD per 1 million tokens, first-party API list prices. Cache writes (5 min) are counted at 1.25x the input price. Usage under a subscription (for example a Claude Code plan) is not billed per token; the board shows the API list-price equivalent. This table is updated by hand: check it against the official pricing page and edit it when prices or models change. A model that is not listed here is left out of the cost totals and the board shows a warning. Where the table gave no cache-read price, the standard 10% of the input price is used.
source: Anthropic API pricing, copied by hand
